title: Vectors: Key derivation consistency
close_reason: Added test_x25519_key_derivation_vector test in test_vectors.py that validates Python implementation against test/vectors/x25519.json. Tests verify clamped_scalar, private_key, and Ed25519 public_key derivation. All 3 vectors pass. This establishes the cross-implementation consistency pattern for Rust/Zephyr to follow.
